selection_policy: Public, active, issue-rich repositories with maintainer-applied labels and domain diversity. Final inclusion still depends on the M2 label-coverage audit.

repositories.name: microsoft/vscode
repositories.rationale: Large, actively triaged issue tracker; explicit bug, feature, question, and duplicate conventions.

repositories.name: microsoft/TypeScript
repositories.rationale: Clear maintainer labels and well-documented duplicate-search workflow.

repositories.name: flutter/flutter
repositories.rationale: High-volume issue tracker with documented triage practice and structured duplicate closure.

repositories.name: kubernetes/kubernetes
repositories.rationale: Mature kind/* taxonomy provides a useful contrast to simple label names.

repositories.name: pandas-dev/pandas
repositories.rationale: Established Bug, Enhancement, and Documentation labels with rich issue text.

repositories.name: scikit-learn/scikit-learn
repositories.rationale: Established issue taxonomy and technically descriptive reports.

repositories.name: huggingface/transformers
repositories.rationale: Domain-relevant repository with large, active issue history.

repositories.name: godotengine/godot
repositories.rationale: Active reports across platforms and visible maintainer-confirmed duplicate events.

repositories.name: rust-lang/rust
repositories.rationale: Prefix-based label taxonomy and long-running issue history.

repositories.name: ansible/ansible
repositories.rationale: Operational-software issues broaden domain coverage and wording.

repositories.name: supabase/supabase
repositories.rationale: Auth/login-heavy web product; bug 4.2k, enhancement 0.4k, documentation 1.0k labelled issues.
repositories.added_reason: Domain coverage: the first 10 repositories are all developer tools; the live demo (a web app) exposed the gap.
